pages.title: Multiplier System
pages.text:
Several factors multiply the nutrition you receive from food:

$(bold)Cooking bonus:$() cooked foods give more nutrition than raw.
$(bold)Variety bonus:$() eating a new food family for the first time today gives a one-time boost.
$(bold)Balance bonus:$() being balanced at the time of eating gives a small multiplier to all nutrition gained.

pages.title: Multiplier System (cont.)
pages.text:
$(bold)Streak penalty:$() eating the same food consecutively reduces the multiplier below 1.
$(bold)Debt penalty:$() being in nutritional debt for a group reduces nutrition gained for that group.
$(bold)Excess penalty:$() a group above 80% absorbs nutrition at a reduced rate until it decays back into range.
